#### The backward pass by hand

Compute the gradient of the [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network)'s mean loss over the [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set)
with respect to $\matr{W}_1$, $\vecf{b}_1$, $\matr{W}_2$ and $\vecf{b}_2$,
using @thm-ce-logit-grad, @sol-linear-param-grad, @sol-linear-input-grad and @sol-relu-grad,
without `.backward()`.
How closely does it match `loss.backward()`?
